title: When advisees are in class
description: Heatmap of the week, weekdays across and time of day down, where each cell's shade shows how many of the advisor's advisees have a planned class meeting then. Selecting a cell lists those advisees and their classes, and selecting a name opens that advisee.

options.flagged: Only advisees with risk flags such as holds, low credits or conflicts
options.cs: Only planned computer science classes, to see when the CS cohort is busy

options.hour: One row per hour, for an at-a-glance view of the week
options.half-hour: One row per 30 minutes, to find an exact free slot for a meeting or advising session

options.counts: The number of advisees in class printed in every busy cell
options.peaks: Only the three busiest times outlined and labelled, to spot peaks quickly

origin.request: Show a heatmap of when my advisees' planned classes meet across the week
